metadata.name: Speech-to-Text Tool
metadata.description: Tool registry integration for speech-to-text transcription using cjpais/Handy repository components (transcribe-rs, cpal, vad-rs)
metadata.author: automated-developer

goals.objective: Initialize Rust project with Cargo.toml containing transcribe-rs, cpal, vad-rs, and supporting dependencies from Handy's architecture

success: Cargo.toml defines transcribe-rs with parakeet feature
cpal, vad-rs, rubato, hound dependencies included
Project compiles with cargo check

goals.objective: Implement microphone audio capture module using cpal following Handy's AudioManager pattern

success: AudioCapture struct wraps cpal input stream
start() begins recording to internal buffer
stop() returns captured samples as Vec<f32>
Automatic resampling to 16kHz via rubato
acceptance: Captures audio from default input device

constraints: Output must be 16kHz mono for transcription compatibility

context.handyReference: Handy uses cpal for cross-platform audio I/O with rubato for resampling

goals.objective: Integrate Voice Activity Detection using vad-rs (Silero) to filter silence from audio before transcription

success: VAD model loads Silero ONNX weights
filter_silence(samples) returns speech-only segments
Configurable speech threshold (default 0.5)
Returns segment timestamps for alignment
acceptance: Processing latency <50ms per second of audio

constraints: Use vad-rs crate matching Handy's implementation

context.handyReference: Handy filters silence using VAD with Silero before Whisper processing

goals.objective: Implement TranscriptionEngine abstraction using transcribe-rs supporting Parakeet V3 (default) and Whisper models

success: TranscriptionEngine trait with load_model() and transcribe()
ParagkeetEngine implementation using transcribe-rs parakeet feature
WhisperEngine implementation using transcribe-rs whisper feature
transcribe() accepts &[f32] samples, returns TranscriptionResult
acceptance: Parakeet V3 transcribes 10s audio in <2s on mid-range CPU
Whisper small model supported for accuracy comparison

constraints: Use transcribe-rs crate (extracted from Handy project)
Model loading separate from transcription for reuse
Support both file path and raw samples input
Return text with optional word-level timestamps

goals.objective: Implement model download and cache management for automatic model acquisition from blob.handy.computer

success: download_model(ModelType) fetches from Handy's blob storage
Models cached in platform-specific directory
list_available_models() returns downloadable models
get_model_path(ModelType) returns local path or triggers download

constraints: Use reqwest for HTTP with progress streaming

goals.objective: Define JSON schema for STT tool interface specifying input parameters and output format for tool registry

success: Input schema defines: action, audio_source, model, language, options
Output schema defines: transcription, segments, metadata
Schema validates against JSON Schema Draft-07

constraints: Support both file input and live recording

inputParams.audio_file: Path to audio file (WAV, MP3, etc.)

goals.objective: Implement end-to-end STT pipeline: audio input → VAD → transcription → structured output

success: transcribe_file(path, options) processes audio files
transcribe_microphone(duration, options) records and transcribes
Pipeline applies VAD when enabled
Returns TranscriptionResult with text and metadata
acceptance: Handles various sample rates via resampling
Graceful error handling for corrupt files

context.pipelineSteps: 1. Load/capture audio → 2. Resample to 16kHz → 3. VAD filter → 4. Transcribe → 5. Format output
context.handyFlow: Handy: Audio → VAD → Whisper/Parakeet → Text output with configurable components

goals.objective: Implement tool registry handler that processes JSON requests and returns structured responses

success: handle(input: Value) -> Result<Value, ToolError> dispatches actions
transcribe_file action processes audio path
transcribe_microphone action records then transcribes
list_models action returns available/downloaded models
acceptance: All actions return valid JSON per output schema

constraints: Stateless handler (models loaded per-request or cached)

context.entryPoint: pub async fn handle(input: serde_json::Value) -> Result<serde_json::Value, ToolError>

goals.objective: Create CLI binary for standalone STT tool invocation and testing

success: stt-tool transcribe <file> outputs transcription
stt-tool record --duration 10 records and transcribes
stt-tool models lists/downloads models
--json flag outputs machine-readable JSON
acceptance: Exit code 0 on success, 1 on error

goals.objective: Write unit and integration tests covering audio capture, VAD, transcription, and tool handler

success: Unit tests for each module with mocked dependencies
Integration tests with real audio fixtures
Tool handler tests cover all action paths
acceptance: Tests pass on CI (Linux, macOS, Windows)

constraints: Mock audio devices for unit tests

goals.objective: Write README and API documentation covering installation, usage, and model management

success: README.md with installation, quick start, CLI reference
Rustdoc comments on all public APIs
Model setup guide for manual installation

constraints: Reference Handy repository for implementation details

context.sections: Overview, Installation, Quick Start, CLI Reference, Library API, Model Management, Supported Audio Formats, Troubleshooting
context.architectureDiagram: Audio Input → Resample (16kHz) → VAD Filter → Transcription Engine → Text Output

goals.objective: Package STT tool for registration with tool registry including manifest and health check

success: tool-manifest.json defines metadata, schema, capabilities
Tool exposes standard entry point for registry
Health check endpoint verifies model availability
